title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Deep Learning in Practice

questions.text: In the context of processing loan application documents, what is a key advantage of using deep learning over traditional machine learning?
options: It requires analysts to manually select variables like salary and employment years.
It automatically identifies patterns from raw scanned documents without manual feature engineering.
It only works with structured tabular data.
It eliminates the need for any human oversight.
questions.explanation: Deep learning models learn hierarchical representations directly from raw data, removing the need for manual feature design.

questions.text: For simple tabular data such as basic sales logs, traditional machine learning is often faster and cheaper than deep learning.
questions.explanation: The narration says traditional models like decision trees are often faster and cheaper for basic tabular spreadsheets.
